generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential from 1, unique per table; never NULL. When appending to a compact DB, start above max(compact PK) so generated PKs never collide.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_pk: Short unique token: prefix of table abbreviation + zero-padded counter (e.g. 'D001'); never NULL. When appending, skip any token already present in the compact DB. If a per_column_exceptions enum must occupy the PK column, emit only enum values not already present in the compact DB; if the enum domain is exhausted, keep fresh tokens and record the shortfall.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_fk: Copy from the FINAL parent key pool (generated + compact) after all parent post-processing; nullable FKs get NULL share ~10% and at least one NULL row; every non-NULL value must exist in the written parent table.
generic_sampling_rules.short_code: Random token of 1-3 alphanumeric chars from a small pool; duplicates allowed unless PK.
generic_sampling_rules.description_text: Random phrase from a small pool of 3-8 words; duplicates allowed.
generic_sampling_rules.name_text: Random person-like or title-like string; duplicates allowed.
generic_sampling_rules.url_text: http://<random-host>/<n>.jpg; choose host/path pools so the distinct-value count yields a 20-50% duplicate share.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_count: Uniform integer in [0, 10000]; NULL share 0 unless nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.nullable_text: Non-NULL value from pool; NULL share per compact-database share (fallback ~10%) with at least one NULL row.
generic_sampling_rules.near_variant: For LIKE/equality literals: include exact literal, one prefix/suffix variant, one case variant, one near-miss (e.g. 'CV','CV x','cv','CW').
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_numeric: For each listed literal L: include L-1, L, L+1 (or step-appropriate neighbors).
generic_sampling_rules.tie_order: Ensure at least two rows share the ORDER key value at the listed rank; plant the tie AFTER any aggregate adjustment that could change the key, and re-verify the aggregate target afterwards.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicate_distinct: Choose the number of distinct values so the duplicate share falls in [20%, 50%]; use d = int(n*0.7) (mid-range) rather than the upper bound so the share stays valid under table-size jitter; compute the share on non-NULL values only and assert it after the NULL rule.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: Nullable columns: NULL share from the compact database's per-column share; at least one NULL row per column per instance; never replace a planted NULL to satisfy a rule; never NULL a row that carries a planted construction target (tie, group-size representative, SUM-boundary row, boundary literal). Protection is keyed by (table, column) and scoped to the owning table.
generic_sampling_rules.append_model: table_sizes_per_instance counts GENERATED rows appended to the compact DB. All construction targets (group sizes, ties, SUM boundary, duplicate shares, unmatched parents) are realized on the generated rows only; the program must verify each target on the generated rows and must not rely on compact rows to satisfy them. Generated PKs must not collide with compact PKs.
generic_sampling_rules.sum_target_construction: Set the target SUM first: counts[i] = target // n, remainder to the first rows, all within [0,10000]. Then plant the rank-1 tie by lowering two rows to the minimum and compensating the difference on other rows within [0,10000]. Apply the delta in one step (or spread it) — no bounded-step loop. Recompute the SUM over non-NULL rows after the NULL rule and assert it equals the target.
generic_sampling_rules.group_size_construction: Assign distinct domain values to the size-1, size-2 and size->=3 groups deterministically; distribute the remainder without merging into the size-1 or size-2 groups; verify the resulting group-size multiset contains 1, 2 and >=3 (and 4, 5 where the domain allows).
generic_sampling_rules.unmatched_parent_construction: Construct unmatched-parent targets explicitly on the generated rows and assert after FK assignment that at least one parent row has no child.

targets: tie at rank 1 ASC and DESC on COUNT(*)
tie at rank 1 ASC on COUNT(*)
groups of size 1, 2, >=3 (relaxed to domain size)
tie at rank 1 DESC on COUNT(*)
groups of size 1, 2, >=3 (relaxed to domain size)

parent_functional_area_code IS NULL OR parent_functional_area_code IN (SELECT functional_area_code FROM Functional_Areas)

supporting_evidence: Documents.document_type_code enum from sample: Book, Paper, Advertisement, CV.
Users.role_code sample values PROJ-MGR, DBA match Roles.role_code.
Functional_Areas.parent_functional_area_code sample value 8 is an existing code.
uncertainty: No formula found for any calculated column; all columns are independent or FK-copied.

Document_Sections.section_title has only 2 distinct observed values ('after','before'); treated as free text with a controlled 20-50% duplicate share on non-NULL values; additional distinct titles may be synthesized to reach the target.

Users.user_login values are stored as the strings '0','1','2'; boundary targets 0,1,2 are realized as both equality and >= comparisons (SQLite type affinity makes numeric comparison work). The column is VARCHAR(40) with numeric-string content; comparisons rely on SQLite affinity.
SQLite LIKE is ASCII case-insensitive by default, so the 'cv' variant matches '%CV%'.
No date columns present, so no order rules needed.
FK assignment must run after all parent post-processing and be validated against the final written parent key sets (generated + compact); fk_violations must be 0.

Group-size and tie targets must be realized on the actual FK value domain of the GENERATED rows; Users.role_code and Roles.role_code use the 2 available roles, so the >=3 group size is relaxed to what the domain allows.

SUM boundary and rank-1 tie on Documents.access_count must be verified by construction after the SUM adjustment and after the NULL rule (NULLs excluded from SUM); assert the final SUM equals the target and at least two non-NULL rows share the minimum. No silent approximate fallback.

The NULL rule must not overwrite rows carrying planted construction targets; protect only the load-bearing rows (tie rows, SUM-boundary rows, boundary literals, group-size representatives), not all rows, so at least one NULL row per nullable column is achievable.

Unmatched-parent targets (Document_Structures without Documents children, Documents without Document_Sections children) must be constructed explicitly on the generated rows and asserted after FK assignment.
Images.image_name distinct pool must be extended (or synthesized) to at least 12 entries so the 20-50% duplicate share target is met by construction for n=15.
table_sizes_per_instance counts generated rows appended to the compact DB; generated PKs must not collide with compact PKs (integer PKs offset above max(compact), varchar PKs skip existing tokens).

Roles.role_code enum overwrite must skip tokens already present in the compact DB; if the compact DB already contains 'DBA' and 'PROJ-MGR', the generated Roles rows keep fresh tokens and the enum shortfall is recorded.
